description: Sensitivity of the lever ranking to the swept range on the profit-shifted share. tau_k is exactly linear in that parameter, so the swing scales with the range width.
verified_source: Torslov, Wier and Zucman (2023); a second verified source was sought and not obtained
conclusion: The ranking is not stable. A range of 0.48 plus or minus 0.16 moves profit shifting to first. The paper therefore claims ownership matters MORE than profit shifting, not that profit shifting is irrelevant.
